about: Incorporated in 1996, Orkla India Limited is an Indian food company, offering a diverse range of food products, from breakfast to lunch and dinner, snacks, beverages, and desserts. [1] It has iconic heritage Indian brands – MTR, Eastern and Rasoi Magic.
